title: OpenCues KATA.md frontmatter
description: JSON Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a KATA.md file. Spec: opencues/0.5-alpha. See /spec/kata-spec.md. All frontmatter keys are optional; a KATA.md with no frontmatter is valid and derives name/title from the folder name. The step sections (## headings) live in the markdown body and are not schema'd here — the body is opaque coach-prompt material per the spec.

name.description: Stable identifier. Defaults to the folder name when omitted. Used for `start kata <name> _` invocation and as a `next:` target.

id.description: Optional invocation shorthand (`start kata 3 _`). A leading `#` is stripped. Numeric or string; no ordering is implied.

title.description: Human-readable lesson title. Defaults to name when omitted.

next.description: Curriculum link — the name or id of the kata to suggest on completion. A dangling link degrades silently.

spec.description: Optional spec-version pin. KATA.md is new in 0.5-alpha; a 0.1-alpha reader ignores the katas/ directory entirely, so omitting spec: is safe.
